lines: Any enemy of Rohan is a friend of Dunland!
The Strawheads of Rohan took our lands from us.
We Dunlendings are a proud and fierce race.
Death on the Men of Rohan!
Our feud with the thieving Rohirrim is centuries old.
The land of Rohan should be ours by rights. Those filthy Strawheads of the River have no claim on it!
Those filthy Strawheads will pay for taking our lands from us!
The land will run red with the blood of Rohan yet!
The day will come, indeed, when the Men of Rohan will answer for what they've done!
Death! Death on the robbers of the North!
The Strawheads came down from the North and took our fathers' lands from them. They'll pay for it in blood, mark my words.
Ruled all of Middle-earth, our kin did, before the Go-hilleg came from across the sea.
Some folk still live out in the Enedwaith, but few and far between, they are.
I don't trust that wizard, but mayhap he'll lead us to victory over the accursed Strawheads.
Those Stawheads are murderers, they are.
Curse the Go-hilleg, and curse the Forgoil!
The Horsemen took our lands, they drove our people into the hills to scratch a living of rocks!
Rohan can't stand against the union of both Dunland and Isengard.
Soon, avenge our ancestors, we will.
It's a tidy alliance we have with Saruman, but I still don't trust him.
The great King Wulf in the days of old nearly defeated the men of Rohan.
We will avenge our ancestors!
Careful crossing south beyond the Isen, they say demons live in those woods.
They say all those who cross into the forests beyond the Isen are never heard from again.
An odd bunch of fishermen and hunters live near the coasts, I hear.
Those of us who swear loyalty to the White Hand are sent up north, I wonder why.
Don't trust the lies those scheming Horse-lords tell you, those lands were ours long before they came down from the north.
Good day.
Good day, #p.
Good morning.
I love the fresh fog lingering in the morning.
Morning!
Good morning, #p!
Good afternoon.
Good afternoon, #p.
Good evening.
I wish a good evening on you.
Good evening, #p.
Evening!
Have a good night.
Have a nice night, #p.
Sleep well, #p.
Have a nice night, be safe!
Careful wandering too far in the woods at night, #p. There are wolves about.
Shall you help us reclaim what is rightfully ours?
We've sworn vengeance on the people of Rohan. Will you stand with us?
Will you fight alongside us, then?
What is it you're wanting?
You're not with Strawheads, are you?
We've always had trouble with foreigners, I hope you're different.
Bringing trouble, are you?
I don't quite trust you.
Will you help us avenge our ancestors?
Will you help us take back our lands?
Where to have you come from?
Where's it you've come from, then?
Well met, friend!
Help us take back our lands.
Fight with us, #p.
Well met, #p. What news are you bringing from your travels, then?
Ah, well met to you, #p. And what tales have you from the road?
Well met, #p, my friend. What tidings have you gathered on your wandering?
Have you come to fight with us?
Together, we will take back the lands that were stolen from us.
You are a good friend, #p.
You have been of great help to us, #p.
I'm glad to see we share a common enemy.
#p, is it true that the King of Rohan lies ill?
Some of my kin have been sent to the North by Saruman the Wise, do you know when they'll return?
You've slain many of our enemies, I hear, you have my thanks #p.
Do you bear any news from our chieftains?
You are a great warrior #p.
You should join us for a feast sometime, #p. You can tell us tales of your adventures.
You're always welcome in Dunland, #p.
You're always welcome into my home, #p.
Thank you for everything you have done for us, #p.
You've done so much for us, #p. Thank you.
They say war is brewing in the South, we may yet have victory over Rohan if their allies are distracted.
What are our orders, chief?
Have you heard from the other chieftains.
What are our orders, #p?
Mind your own business.
By rights, you shouldn't be eavesdropping.
Eavesdropping now, are we?
I wasn't talking to you, was I?
Go bother me later, I'm busy.
Leave me be.
It's rude to interupt, #p.
Do you mind? I was in the middle of a conversation
#p! I was just in the middle of a conversation.
A bit rude to interrupt, isn't it?
There's no need to interrupt, is there?
...and I turned to him and said - excuse me? Do you mind interrupting us, #p?
...he'll turn out to be a fine warrior, I'm sure - oh, hello there #p!
Oh - hello #p, we were just talking about the upcoming festival in Dunland.
...personally, I think Saruman will make Dunland great again - ah, hello #p!
...and they say after my grandfather crossed the Isen, he was never seen again - ah, how can I help you #p?
Hello #p, we were just finishing up, what do you need from me?
How can I help you, #p?
Why, hello #p!
Oh, hey #p, I didn't see you there.
I hear #p lead an entire legion of Dunlendings to their deaths - oh... well met #p...
You're an honorable warrior, #p.
Few outsiders have pledged their service to us, you're an honorable warrior, #p.
You may not be Dunlending by blood, but you are still one of us now.
Didn't want to spend my day trudging through all this muck!
Well now all my clothes are wet!
Hope we don't get into a skirmish in this weather.
Let's hurry inside!
We should find some cover, #p.
Glad to have some shelter from this rain.
Sounds like theres a lot of rain out there.
Good time to be inside right now, with how wet it is today.
I hope the roof is good enough to keep us dry.
This weather today is dreadful, isn't it?
Tidy weather for ducks today.
Rain already? I haven't even patched the thatch up yet.
Ha! The moon is stained with the blood of our enemies!
The moon is stained with the blood of Rohan!
Hey  now, don't be hasty!
Slow down #p, you're talking a bit too fast for me, you are.
It's rude to talk over someone!
Let me finish talking!
How rude!
Slow down!
Our kin once spread far and wide, they did, but now all that's left of our people is here.
Used to host some of Durin's Folk here, we did. Father always said they were the finest smiths ever seen.
The Horsemen took our lands, they drove our people into these hills to scratch a living of rocks!
If the horse-lords are your enemy, then you're welcome among us.
Stranger, what is it you're wanting in our lands?
Welcome to Dunland stranger, so long as you're an enemy of Rohan.
You're not bringing trouble here, are you?
Welcome to our lands stranger, at least whats left of them.
Welcome to Dunland!
Welcome to Dunland, #p.
Welcome to our lands #p, at least whats left of them.
Let us reclaim our homeland of old!
For wrath! For ruin! For our forefathers!
We shall swarm into Rohan like a plague.
For Dunland!
Lead us to war, #p!
We go to victory!
We Dunlendings are bold and strong warriors! We shall not fail you in battle!
Come, #! Let us together avenge my people!
It is time for the filthy Rohirrim to pay for their crimes!
We fight for you!
The filthy Strawheads shall fear our name! Lead us to war and triumph, #p!
We shall make our forefathers proud!
The blood of Rohan will flow tonight!
Lead us to victory!
Well someone's a little tipsy aren't they?
Looks like you've spent too long at the tavern!
Ha! Looks like someone can't hold their ale!
You might want to hold off on the ale for a bit.
I'm suprised you can even stand!
Did you drink too much mead, aye?
Drunk too much, have you?
By rights, you shouldn't even be conscious after drinking so much!
You looking for a fight?
Oh ho! To the bottle I go!
You're a beautiful girl, #p.
What did you just say about me?
Tonight, #p, we shall feast like kings!
Hands off my drink!
Splish splash splosh! Splish splash plump!
To and fro! To and fro! Up we come! Down we go!
Good day, #! Or is it morning? No, it's night! Ha! Ha!
Hey ho! To the bottle I go!
Ale! Ale! Sweet ale! Oh yes! Yes!
Death to Dunland... I mean Rohan!
The bottle is my saviour! To the bottle I must go!
This mug shall be the bane of all Rohirrim!
I only had three mugs... or four. Five at the most, mind.
You looking at me? Well, look somewhere else, then.
The chief knows my name, he does. Owes me money too.
Now where'd I leave my cup? Had it a moment ago, I did.
The road's moving again. Happens every time I stand up.
Hold still, would you? You're making the room wobble.
I've wrestled sheep tougher than you!
Who's singing? Stop it, I'm trying to fight!
Right then, I've forgotten why we're fighting, but we're finishing it!
I'll throw you out of this place, I will.
Rahhhhhh! To glorious battle!
Another ale! Wait, whose that charging at me!
I'll *hic* kill *hic* you!
Somethings not right with this forest, I tell you!
Heard strange tales about this wood, I have.
I hear this wood is haunted by tree-spirits!
Watch your back in this forest, #p.
Did that tree just move?
By rights we shouldn't even be near this accursed wood!
This forest is cursed, it is.
I don't quite trust this Saruman fellow.
The wizard has built a tidy army for himself, the horse-lords will surely fall now.
Hard to breathe here, it is.
Watch your step, #p, almost fell into one of their mines myself.
Our kin lived within these walls long ago, before it fell into the hands of the wizard.
I don't trust these filthy orcs.
Wish we didn't need all these orcs, they have no care for our people, see.
I don't like fighting alongside these orcs, but if it leads us to victory...
These orcs are demons, they are.
I'm fine fighting with these orcs, so long as I'm standing behind them.
Is fighting alongside these demons even worth it? Wulf never needed orcs when he waged war.
Why can't we call our allies in the South to fight with us like the great Wulf once did?
Burn every village! Leave none alive!
Let's take back the lands they stole from us! Burn every village!
These lands are ours by rights!
We will take back the lands they stole from us.
Death on the Strawheads!
Death on the Men of Rohan!
These land will run red with the blood of Rohan!
Those filthy Strawheads will pay for taking our lands from us!
Death on the Forgoil! Death on the Strawheads!

We've had many dealings with Durin's Folk in the past, they're a fair and honest people.
We've always welcomed trade with Durin's folk, we have.

Understand those who've lost their lands, we do, Durin's Folk are welcome among us.

We share in our hatred for the Men of the West!
Together, the Men of the West will fail, and the White City will burn, see!
Brought goods from far away lands, did we?
Long ago, your people assisted our king Wulf in assailing the Horse-lords, we will never forget what you did for us.
My grandfather always spoke of bright fruits from the far South, do you happen to bring some?
Is it true the Uruk-hai feast only on the flesh of men?

I don't quite trust those orcs of yours, but so long as they lead us to victory...
The White Hand will lead us to victory over the accursed Strawheads!
